translation: <ins>Baijiaoxiang San</ins> (White Resin Powder, 白膠香散) treats broken skin and severed sinews. Baijiaoxiang (white resin) alone, ground into a fine powder and applied. <ins>Another formula:</ins> Jinfeicao (Inula) root, pound to extract the juice, apply to the sinew to close the wound; in fourteen days it can rejoin and stop the pain.
